text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - wg-runtime-POOL node wg-node-08 is OOM'ing and entering RestartLoop. Containers killed: inference-runtime. Symptoms: slow mem creep in kv-cache/paged-attn allocator, occasional CUDA driver errors. Alerting: autoscaler triggered.

maria: I'm on it, grabbing logs + heap profiles.

aj: assigning watch. can you paste the pod logs / dmesg?

devin: paste: 
```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Kill process 24567 (inference-runt) total-vm:1023456kB, anon-rss:860000kB
[ 1234.568001] python3 invoked oom-killer: cgroup memory
```
Also seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in container logs right before restart.

sre_jason: temp mitigation: cordon wg-node-08 + drain non-critical pods, scale down batch_size for prod-models to 1, and set KVCACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.7 on runtime. That should slow the ramp.

ops_emma: customer-impact: errors spiking ~2.3% across hosted endpoints in us-west-2, latency p95 up +400ms. Impacting a handful of paying customers (billing alerts fired).

maria: running `kubectl exec -c runtime $POD -- /bin/sh -c 'echo compact > /proc/kvcache/control'` to trigger compact cycle (manual compaction supported in this build). Will watch mem.

aj: note for triage: this looks like page-fragmentation in the paged-attn allocator — long sequences + mixed quantization profiles creating many tiny pages that never free. Past fixes helped but this pattern is new.

devin: uploading heapdump -> s3://redwood-debug/dumps/1771234567/heap.tgz

sre_jason: also flip routing policy to fallback-model-1 (smaller kv footprint) for high-QPS customers for next 15m.

ops_emma: @customers-ops notified, CS pinged top-5 affected customers. Logging incident message to status.redwood.ai

maria: mem stabilized after compaction and cordon. usage trending down from 95% -> 70% on wg-node-08. No more CUDA errors in last 4m.

aj: good. leave node cordoned until the fix ships. create rollout with allocator GC patch (PR #3492) to staging, then canary to prod with 10% traffic.

devin: PR includes safer page coalescing + on-alloc sanity checks. Quick patch build ready.

maria: creating handoff note for next shift: root suspect = allocator fragmentation due to mixed-precision quantization path + long-context workloads causing tiny-page accumulation -> slow leak. Mitigations applied: cordon/drain, manual compaction, lower batch_size, route to fallback-model, canary PR for allocator GC. 

aj: checklist for next oncall: 1) watch mem growth on wg-POOL nodes, 2) verify no CUDA_ILLEGAL logs, 3) ensure canary shows no leak for 1h, 4) ready rollback if regressions. Tagging @aj for daytime handover.

ops_emma: adding incident to calendar: postmortem mtg tomorrow 10:30am PST.

maria: handing off to @aj — leaving monitoring links + commands in the thread. :white_check_mark:

aj: taking watch. will update if anything flares. thanks team.

oncall-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Alert channel archived at 1771234690.
